notes.title: 🎉Banshee Update 1.2.6!🎉The nightmare doesn't end!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569022/bdfac11dbf5694573a442f6757b105ddad15b635.png"]

🔧 Update contents

🗺️ Map expansion:

The ability to move outside the window and a garden have been added.



⚙️ Added optional items:

The ability to adjust the viewing angle and volume has been added.



🏆 Steam achievements feature:

Completing certain events will unlock achievements on Steam.



🎬 New movie scene:

A movie of the first encounter with a banshee has been added.



🐺 Added wolf as an enemy character:

A ferocious wolf has been added that will attack the player.



The nightmare doesn't end - a new enemy, the "wolf," creeps into the dark night. Experience the latest update with enhanced Steam achievements and horror effects.

notes.title: 🎉Banshee Update 1.2.4🎉 Now with difficulty settings and multilingual support!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569022/0ef3e8eb6d0760234a6a44820b26059296e6378a.png🔧Update contents

 🕹️Added difficulty settings :   easy/normal/hard, which changes the Banshee's speed depending on the setting.
 🧠Improved Banshee AI :   Prevents getting stuck and will only pull out if hiding extremely close.
 🌍Multilingual support :   Supports three languages: English, Chinese (Simplified), and Japanese.
 ✋Improved item pickup :   Increased the interaction hit range.
 🛠️Bug Fix :   Fixed an issue that could cause players to warp when hiding.


🎮What about the future?
Deeper and more thrilling.
Banshee will continue to evolve. Please look forward to its future developments.
